items.title: Henry A. "Hank" Kmen Interview, 1963-02-13
items.q: I guess Dr. Hogan, I have to tell you more about that.

ctx.x: What sort of racing did they have then? Horses and mules? Anything else?

I guess Dr. Hogan, I have to tell you more about that. I know there was a couple of clubs that got started very early here. One was called the Jockey Club or something like that, but I haven't followed. You haven't come across anything on bands? No, no, and in this respect, I can say I looked at it. You see, I looked at everything, but always looking for music, and if I didn't see music,
that was the end of my interest in it. What about the lake? Did they have music out
